verdict.rationale: ernd is a SaaS corporate card and rewards product, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. An llms.txt file exists, but that is a discovery document, not an MCP server, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
